title: Tenant-level error-budget scoring and automated rollout circuit for model transitions
creator: Asha Patel
description: Define a tenant-scoped SLO framework and an automated rollout circuit that uses per-tenant error-budget scoring to gate model family transitions (e.g., base -> quantized, v1 -> v2). This ticket covers: 1) SLO bands (latency and availability) for streaming and non-streaming endpoints at p50/p95/p99; 2) a numeric per-tenant error-budget score that combines latency, availability, and error-rate signals; 3) an automated circuit that enforces canary step sizes, hold windows, burn-rate checks, and automatic rollback when thresholds are exceeded; and 4) dashboarding and contract tests required for acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Defined SLO bands documented for streaming first-token and tail-token latencies and non-streaming request latencies: p50/p95/p99 with absolute ms targets and per-tenant burst envelopes.
Per-tenant error-budget score formula documented and reviewed (weights for latency tail, 5xx rate, and request abandonment), with examples for low/medium/high-risk tenants.

Automated rollout circuit implemented in deploy orchestration: canaries progress by configurable steps (default 1%, 5%, 20%), hold windows >= 10 minutes between steps, and automatic halt + rollback when burn-rate > 4x for 10m or error-rate increase > 2x baseline.
Contract tests in CI validate that rollout policy will not exceed tenant-level quotas and that rollback triggers fire in synthetic SLO-breach scenarios.
Dashboards and alerting created: per-tenant SLO score, burn-rate, canary cohort latency and errors, with runbook links and escalation steps.
Documentation (PRD + runbook) links added to the issue and reviewed by Eng and SRE; sign-off from Security if required for tenant isolation controls.
rollout_plan: Phase 0 - Design review: finalize score weights and threshold values with Applied ML and SRE teams (2 sprints).
Phase 1 - Prototype: implement scoring in telemetry pipeline and simulated rollouts against synthetic tenants. Disable automatic rollback (manual guard) for safety.
Phase 2 - Canary: enable automated circuit for internal-only tenants; run 3 canary experiments across model families and capture metrics for 72h.
Phase 3 - Gradual rollout: enable for low-risk external tenants with default step sizes and observe for 14 days; collect regressions and adjust thresholds.
Phase 4 - Broad rollout: enable for all tenants and add tenant opt-out/override UI in Console for enterprise customers with approved support workflows.
monitoring_and_alerting: Per-tenant telemetry pipeline emits latency p50/p95/p99, 5xx rate, token-level cancellations, and canary cohort identifiers.
Prometheus alerts: tenant_slo_burn_rate > 4 for 10m -> P0 alert; tenant_canary_error_increase > 2x baseline for 5m -> automated stop and paging.
Grafana dashboard: 'Tenant SLO Scoreboard' with sortable columns and links to recent rollout events and PRs.
Synthetic canary tests run every 5m per model family to surface regressions before customer impact.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: false positives in burn-rate detection due to noisy telemetry. Mitigation: require correlated signal across latency and 5xx rate before automatic rollback.
Risk: enterprise customers require slower rollouts. Mitigation: per-tenant rollout configuration and manual approval workflow exposed in Console.
Risk: incorrect weightings cause overflagging of low-traffic tenants. Mitigation: minimum-request thresholds and smoothing windows in the scoring function.
Risk: dependency on telemetry latency. Mitigation: fallback to longer hold windows and conservative default thresholds if telemetry lag > 30s.
